scientific_integrity: The earlier generalized-lasso diagonal-dominance theorem supplies the sufficient half. Novelty is restricted to the star-specific necessary condition, positive-time counterexamples, and sharp hub-mass feasibility criterion. All universal assertions rely on analytical proof, not finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite star graphs, positive diagonal fidelity and fixed positive edge penalties; no general-tree necessity claim; independently unverified priority and proof.
title: A sharp hub-mass budget for irreversible fusion on weighted stars
